commit.message:
test(cli): assert warnings where refusals and guards were removed

Dispatch-contract, cut-state, branch, cross-package commit and cross-architect
open cases now assert the act goes ahead with a warning; the catalog follows
canon without handoffs, with in-use evaluation and spawns '*'; seeding ignores
the journal's maker stamp. The immutability gate names the harm it prevents
and the way past.
